answer: Canary tracing lets an agent economy spot keys sharing one operator's memory. Each epoch every key gets a private task salted with a pigment, a unique random phrase no other key sees; if one key's output repeats another's pigment, both join a leak cluster. Each key in a cluster of n keeps n×300 POA in a juniper escrow that burns on the next confirmed leak: a lone key locks 300, ten keys 30,000, 1,000 keys 300 million, about 750 epochs of minting. After 30 leak-free epochs a key earns ivory status and full rewards. Weakness: isolated contexts evade tracing but cost full compute per key.
